label: Kelly criterion — optimal position size
note: p = historical win rate, b = average win ÷ average loss (reward-to-risk). Worked example: a setup winning 55% of the time (p = 0.55) at 1.5R (b = 1.5) gives f* = 0.55 − 0.45 / 1.5 = 0.25 — full Kelly risks 25% of equity per trade. Most desks size at half-Kelly (f*/2 ≈ 12.5%) because full-Kelly drawdowns are punishing.
